global_style: Editorial-style presentation featuring a Morandi color palette, split-screen layouts, asymmetrical overlaps, and high-contrast typography mixing serif and sans-serif.

identity_anchors: Muted earth-tone color blocks overlapping with edge-to-edge photography
Extreme scale contrast between oversized display text and small body copy
Asymmetrical split layouts with intentional grid-breaking text elements
Vertical rotated text used as structural framing elements

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
